# Shell bundle baseline

Source: cd07ba8c9e770da233d62e4d08826490bba1f242, successful workflow [45363006908](https://github.com/rodkisten/shell/actions/runs/45363006908), artifact shell-preview-report (14904929250), 2026-11-24. Snapshot supplied from the downloaded artifact by the maintainer.

Scope: dist JS, MJS, CSS and WASM files; raw bytes, gzip level 9 and Brotli quality 11. This fixed reference is not automatically updated. Hashed filenames may appear as new or removed even when logical chunks correspond; aggregate comparisons remain meaningful for equivalent build scope. Total bytes are not initial page transfer size.
